player_prompt.intro: Udlala i-Mastermind. Udinga ukuthola ikhodi enenombolo engu- {code_length}, inombolo ngayinye kusuka ku-1 kuye ku-{num_numbers}, {repeats}. Ekuphenduleni kwakho, ungahambisa ukuqagela kwakho ngale ndlela elandelayo: '[2 1 4 5]'. Ngemuva kokuqagela ngakunye, uzothola impendulo ngesimo sezinhlamvu ezimnyama nezimhlophe. Inhlamvu emnyama ikhombisa inombolo efanele endaweni efanele, kuyilapho inhlamvu emhlophe ikhombisa inombolo efanele endaweni engafanele. Une- {max_turns} ujika ukuqagela ikhodi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Awuphendulanga ngohlu lwezinombolo ezihlukaniswe izikhala ezifakwe kubakaki abakhiwe.
invalid_move.not_integers: Konke okufakiwe kufanele kube izinombolo eziphelele ezivumelekile.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Zonke izinombolo kufanele zibe phakathi kuka-1 no-{num_numbers}.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Usuvele uqagele {guess}. Sicela uzame ukuqagela okuhlukile.

game_action.feedback: Kutholwe [{guess}]. Impendulo: {black_pegs} intambo emnyama, {white_pegs} intambo enhle.

outcome.win: Uyixazulule ikhodi, uxazulule {black_pegs} ngaphandle {code_length} izimbambo kahle
outcome.turn_limit: Umkhawulo wokuphenduka ufinyelelwe. Ulinganise {percent} amaphesenti ezinombolo ngendlela efanele.
